dedupe_keys.name: lamina de agua de las balsas lagos y embalses de andalucia 2005 spot5 hrg

description: Lámina de agua de las balsas, lagos y embalses de Andalucía, 2005 (SPOT5 HRG) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Foil layer of water from the basins, lakes and reservoirs of SIOSE 2005, determined from images of the SPOT5 satellite, captured in 2005 by the HRG sensor (XS and PAN). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Water sheet of the rafts, lakes and reservoirs of Andalusia, 2005 (SPOT5 HRG)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Abastecimiento agrícola de agua, Tratamiento de imágenes, IDEAndalucia, Construcciones hidráulicas, Abastecimiento de agua, Teledetección. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
